# V1.4 — Beta UX overhaul

**Status:** Done, all 8 slices committed on `main`. Beta self-test fixes + IA declutter + Help/Beta screens.

Full plan: `~/.claude/plans/this-prompt-we-re-in-floating-dove.md` (local plan file, not in-repo).

| # | Slice | Model | Commit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Header inset fix (`contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0,0,0,0)` on outer Scaffold) | Sonnet | `36115da` |
| 2 | Data-leak fix (wipe-on-logout + login guard + tests, ADR-0021) | Opus | `6b226fe` |
| 3 | No-spend baseline (registration date lower-bound + tests) | Sonnet | `bc2a643` |
| 4 | Nav foundation — `pinnable` flag, More-sheet dedup, settings route rename | Opus | `b4f89ae` |
| 5 | Manage module merge (Accounts\|Categories\|Budgets tabs) | Opus | `19e44ea` |
| 6 | Couple module merge (Overview\|Combined\|Debts) + color-picker mirror fix | Sonnet | `e1ff0f3` |
| 7 | Records header strip (keep Notes+Recurring only) + Settings sign-out + route rename | Sonnet | `5b32893` |
| 8 | `IS_BETA_BUILD` flag + Settings Support section + Help placeholder + Beta WebView form (ADR-0022) | Sonnet | `f8352dd` |

**Slice 2 (`6b226fe`, ADR-0021):** sign-out now wipes local Room data + a login-time guard prevents a stale session from leaking a previous account's data on a shared device.

**Slice 6 summary (`e1ff0f3`):** `CoupleScreen` rewritten as a tab host — Overview | Combined | Debts, visible only when fully paired, bare overview otherwise. `CombinedBody`+`PartnerDebtBody` extracted as chrome-less composables. Fixed a color-picker mirror bug (single `AccentColorRow` above both Create/Join cards). `COMBINED`/`PARTNER_DEBT` removed from `NavRegistry.all` (now internal tabs, not top-level pinnable destinations).

**Slice 7 (`5b32893`):** Records header stripped to Notes (pencil) + Recurring (repeat) icons only — Couple/Settings/SignOut icons removed. `PersonalizeScreen` renamed "Personalize" → "Settings", gained a "Sign out" `TextButton` (error color) at the bottom.

**Slice 8 (`f8352dd`):** `BuildConfig.IS_BETA_BUILD` on both flavors (`true` staging, `false` prod at the time — flipped to `true` on prod in [V1.6](v1.6.md)). `feature/feedback/presentation/`: `BetaFeedbackConfig` (Google Form URL + entry ID map, `buildPrefillUrl()`), `BetaFeedbackViewModel`, `BetaFeedbackScreen` (WebView). `feature/help/presentation/HelpScreen` (static FAQ + version footer). `PersonalizeScreen` gets a "Support" section (Help always shown, Beta feedback gated by `IS_BETA_BUILD`).

429 JVM tests green at the end of this batch; `assembleStagingDebug` green.
